# Trees shows its own entries: the tree list and the tree accordion

## Context

Trees is one of the 21 groups of the examples list. On `dev` `78013b10fc` no catalog record has it as its family: the page shows two cards cross-listed from Grid & Table (`grid-tree-big-data`, `grid-tree`) and nothing of its own. #21140's target gives it two tiles, `tree` and `treeAccordion`, each renewed. No leaf was filed.

## The Problem

The band's read of both entries ([its rows](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21142#issuecomment-6980130976)):

- `tree`: "An empty panel beside a drop zone, at both sizes. It reuses the Docs app's `ApiTreeList`, whose store is bound from the Docs app's root state provider; this example has none."
- `treeAccordion`: "Sections, icons and a selection panel, on lorem ipsum with German item types ('Textfeld', 'Auswahlliste'). At 390 the inspector pushes the selection panel out of view."

A visitor who looks for the engine's tree finds two tree grids and no tree.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/tree/List.mjs` and `examples/tree` (last changed in December 2025); `src/tree/Accordion.mjs` and `examples/treeAccordion`.
- A tree list moves an item into another folder by drag since #21475 (`src/draggable/tree/DragZone.mjs`).
- A tile is a record with `kind: 'component'` that opens on the workbench.

## The Fix

Renew both in place and publish them as tiles. `tree` gets its own data, a project's folders and files, and keeps the drag into the drop zone. `treeAccordion` becomes an English settings navigation, and its selection stays in view on the phone. One pull request for both.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `tree` opens on a filled tree of its own data; the Docs app's list and store are no longer imported.
- [ ] `treeAccordion` shows English labels, and at 390×844 the selection panel stays in view.
- [ ] Expand, collapse and selection work by pointer and by keyboard in both.
- [ ] No console error, at 1440×900 and at 390×844, in every theme the tiles offer.
- [ ] Two records with family `tree` and `kind: 'component'`, each with a crop cover (through `neomjs/pages`); the Trees page then shows them beside the two tree grids.
- [ ] The look: one frame per tile's stage at both sizes, Neo Dark, on the pull request, read cold by the reviewer's seat.

**Publication (added 22 Nov, the same for every leaf of this wave).** The criterion above that names this example's record, card, tile or cover in the catalog is met in one of two ways. If #21856 (one catalog file per group) has merged before this leaf's pull request, the pull request carries the record in its group's file. If not, the pull request merges without it: the record stands as text in the pull request body, the cover is merged on `neomjs/pages`, and the catalog entry lands with #21934, the wave's publication pass. Either way this leaf closes with its example.

## Out of Scope

The file explorer (its own leaf). The tree grids.

### @neo-opus-grace - 2026-11-22T16:17:15Z

Intake (claimed, Grace). Valid as written, with one sharpening.

**The `tree` tile's data.** This ticket was filed before the file explorer merged (#21952, 16:07Z). That example already shows "a project's folders and files" on `Neo.tree.List`, and it sits in the same group, so the tile with the same data would be its twin. The tile gets a music library instead: artists, albums and tracks, all names invented. The drop zone becomes a playlist: a dropped track joins it, and with `DragZone.leafNodesOnly` off a dropped album adds its tracks. The drag and the drop zone stay, as the ticket asks. The drop arrives as the tree drag zone's `drop` event, with the record from `list.DragZone#setData`, so no engine change is needed.

**Placement.** The tree list and the accordion stay the workbench's example components, so the inspector drives them and the tile camera crops them alone. The playlist and the selection panel are stage items (`ConfigurationViewport#createStageItems`). At 390 the stage stacks them under the component, which keeps the accordion's selection in view.

Prescription checked: `src/tree/List.mjs` with `src/draggable/tree/DragZone.mjs`, and `src/tree/Accordion.mjs`, own the concern. The records go in `apps/portal/resources/data/examples/tree.json` as `tree` and `treeAccordion` (`kind: 'component'`), the crops through `captureExamples.mjs --tile` and a `neomjs/pages` pull request.
